CustomField.description: Survey Response to survey sent about this case. Populated by Flow when Survey Response record is created, based on the Case Id value passed in from Typeform Integration. Used to display CSAT Score and CSAT Score Comments as formula field on Case record. Read Only to all but Admins (via profile) and Typeform Integration User (via permission set)
